def re_arrange(arr, n):
    pos = []
    neg = []
    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] >= 0:
            pos.append(arr[i])
        else:
            neg.append(arr[i])
    pos.sort()
    neg.sort()
    i = 0
    j = 0
    k = 0
    while i < len(pos) and j < len(neg):
        arr[k] = neg[j]
        k += 1
        j += 1
        arr[k] = pos[i]
        k += 1
        i += 1
    while i < len(pos):
        arr[k] = pos[i]
        k += 1
        i += 1
    while j < len(neg):
        arr[k] = neg[j]
        k += 1
        j += 1
    return arr
